name: How long does kitchen drywall installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen drywall installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen drywall installation depends on the project's scope, whether it's a new build or a renovation, and the kitchen size. For a standard kitchen renovation requiring drywall replacement, the installation itself (hanging, taping, mudding, and sanding) can take approximately 3-7 days. This estimate does not include demolition or painting. Factors like complex layouts, high ceilings, or extensive repairs can extend this timeline. We aim for efficient completion while ensuring quality finishing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen drywall installation usually takes 3-7 days for hanging, taping, mudding, and sanding, depending on kitchen size and project complexity.
